qa_pairs.question: How much memory and storage does the NovaBook 14 have, and what charger does it use?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The NovaBook 14 has 16 GB of memory and a 512 GB solid-state drive. It charges through either USB-C port with a 65 W USB-C Power Delivery adapter. A lower-wattage adapter may charge slowly and may not maintain charge during heavy use.

contexts.text: The NovaBook 14 is a 14-inch laptop with two USB-C ports, one USB-A port, 16 GB of memory, and a 512 GB solid-state drive. It charges through either USB-C port with a 65 W USB-C Power Delivery adapter. A lower-wattage adapter may charge slowly but may not maintain charge during heavy use.

qa_pairs.question: When is an online order created at OrbitTech?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An online order is created when OrbitTech displays an order number and sends a confirmation email. A pending card authorization alone is not proof that the order was accepted.

contexts.text: An online order is created when OrbitTech displays an order number and sends a confirmation email. A pending card authorization is not proof that the order was accepted.

qa_pairs.question: How long does standard domestic shipping normally take after dispatch?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch. This is a service estimate, not a guarantee.

contexts.text: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch. Express shipping normally arrives in one to two business days after dispatch. These are service estimates, not guarantees.

qa_pairs.question: For an order placed on or after September 1, 2026, how long can an unopened standard device be returned?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An unopened standard device can be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery for orders placed on or after September 1, 2026.

contexts.text: For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery.

qa_pairs.question: What credentials will OrbitTech staff never request?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitTech staff will never request a password or one-time authentication code.

contexts.text: OrbitTech staff will never request a password or one-time authentication code.

qa_pairs.question: What SIM, charging, and carrier-related limitations apply to the PulsePhone X?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The PulsePhone X has one physical nano-SIM slot and one eSIM profile active at a time. It supports USB-C charging and wireless charging up to 15 W, but it does not include a charger in the box. Carrier activation, network coverage, and third-party eSIM eligibility are controlled by the carrier rather than OrbitTech.

contexts.text: The PulsePhone X is a dual-SIM smartphone with one physical nano-SIM slot and one eSIM profile active at a time. It supports USB-C charging and wireless charging up to 15 W. The phone does not include a charger in the box. Carrier activation, network coverage, and third-party eSIM eligibility are controlled by the carrier rather than OrbitTech.

qa_pairs.question: What are the payment requirements and failure consequence for an eligible OrbitPay instalment purchase?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An eligible device purchase must be at least USD 300 after discounts. OrbitPay requires 25% at checkout followed by three equal monthly payments, and gift cards cannot fund the initial 25%. A failed instalment has a seven-calendar-day retry period; continued failure may suspend the account from new instalment purchases but does not remotely disable the device.

contexts.text: OrbitPay instalments are available for eligible device purchases of at least USD 300 after discounts. The plan requires 25% at checkout and three equal monthly payments. Gift cards cannot fund the initial 25%.
A failed instalment receives a seven-calendar-day retry period; continued failure may suspend the account from new instalment purchases but does not remotely disable the device.

qa_pairs.question: When does cancelling OrbitPlus within 14 calendar days produce a full membership refund?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Cancelling OrbitPlus within 14 calendar days produces a full membership refund only if no member discount, free shipping, or priority service has been used. If any of those benefits has been used, the membership remains active until its annual expiry and is not refunded.

contexts.text: Cancelling membership within 14 calendar days produces a full membership refund only if no member discount, free shipping, or priority service has been used. Otherwise, the membership remains active until its annual expiry and is not refunded.
The membership benefit must be active when the order is placed. Activating OrbitPlus after an order does not retroactively change the price or shipping fee.

qa_pairs.question: What must a customer do after receiving visible shipping damage or missing items?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Visible shipping damage or missing items must be reported within 48 hours after confirmed delivery. The customer should keep the packaging and provide photographs of the label, box, and contents.

contexts.text: Visible shipping damage or missing items must be reported within 48 hours after confirmed delivery.
The customer should keep the packaging and provide photographs of the label, box, and contents.

qa_pairs.question: What is required for a return, and when are refunds issued after inspection?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A return requires the order number, all included parts, and removal of personal accounts and activation locks. Customers should back up and erase personal data before returning a device. After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days; gift-card portions return to a replacement gift card.

contexts.text: A return requires the order number, all included parts, and removal of personal accounts and activation locks.
Customers should back up and erase personal data before returning a device. OrbitTech is not responsible for data left on a returned product.
After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days. Gift-card portions return to a replacement gift card.

qa_pairs.question: What warranty period applies to the main devices and AeroBuds Pro, and what proof is needed for a claim?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The NovaBook 14, PulsePhone X, and HomeHub Mini have a 24-month limited hardware warranty, while the AeroBuds Pro and separately purchased OrbitTech accessories have a 12-month warranty. A claim requires an order number or other acceptable proof of purchase; without proof, OrbitTech may use the recorded serial-number shipment date, which can shorten the apparent coverage period.

contexts.text: OrbitTech provides a 24-month limited hardware warranty for the NovaBook 14, PulsePhone X, and HomeHub Mini. The AeroBuds Pro and separately purchased OrbitTech accessories have a 12-month warranty.

A claim requires an order number or other acceptable proof of purchase. When proof is unavailable, OrbitTech may use the recorded serial-number shipment date, which can shorten the apparent coverage period.

qa_pairs.question: How long do diagnosis and a covered repair normally take, and what happens if a part is unavailable too long?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product. A covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available, excluding shipping and time waiting for customer approval. If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

contexts.text: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product. A covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available.
These periods exclude shipping time and time waiting for customer approval.
If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

qa_pairs.question: A confirmed order needs to be shipped to another country. Can support change the destination, and what cancellation option is documented?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The shipping address may be edited only while the order is Confirmed, but changing the destination country is never allowed. The customer must cancel and place a new order. Cancellation from the account page is available while the order is Confirmed; once it is Packing, cancellation is no longer guaranteed.

contexts.text: The shipping address may be edited only while an order is `Confirmed`. For security, changing the destination country is never allowed; the customer must cancel and place a new order.
An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`. Once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed.

qa_pairs.question: Which return rule applies to an order placed before September 1, 2026 by an OrbitPlus member, and can the 45-day benefit apply retroactively?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The policy version in force on the order-placement date controls return-policy eligibility. An order placed before September 1, 2026 keeps version 1.0: 21 days for an unopened device, seven days for an opened device, and a 15% opened-device restocking fee, regardless of membership. The 45-day OrbitPlus unopened-device extension applies only to version 2.0 orders when OrbitPlus was active on the order date, so it does not apply retroactively to the earlier order.

contexts.text: For return-policy eligibility, the triggering event is the order-placement date, while the number of return days is counted from confirmed delivery.

Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026. It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices, seven calendar days for opened devices, and charged a 15% opened-device restocking fee.
Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership. For version 2.0 orders, the extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date.
OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership is active.

qa_pairs.question: How should a customer handle a defective opened standard device inside the return window versus after that window?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and normally has a 10% restocking fee, but a defect verified during the return window is not charged that fee. After the return window, a covered defect follows the warranty and repair process rather than the return policy. The warranty is separate from the return policy and covers defects in materials or workmanship under normal use.

contexts.text: An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. A defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.
Warranty service after the return window follows `06_warranty_policy.md` and `07_repair_and_technical_support.md`.
The warranty covers defects in materials or workmanship under normal use.

qa_pairs.question: What escalation and complaint paths apply when a repair part is unavailable for more than 15 business days or a team misses its response period?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: If a required repair part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy. A formal service complaint may be filed after the assigned team misses a published response period or closes a case without addressing the stated issue; the complaint should include the case number, requested resolution, and relevant evidence, and a supervisor reviews it within five business days.

contexts.text: If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

A formal service complaint may be filed after the assigned team misses a published response period or closes a case without addressing the stated issue. The complaint should identify the case number, requested resolution, and relevant evidence. A supervisor reviews it within five business days.

qa_pairs.question: What should a customer do after suspecting account compromise if an unauthorized order is Confirmed versus already Packing or dispatched?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The customer should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If an unauthorized order is still Confirmed, the customer should also attempt cancellation. If it is already Packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with Payments and Delivery, but cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security.

If an unauthorized order is still `Confirmed`, the customer should also attempt cancellation under `02_orders_and_payments.md`. If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams; cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.
Once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed.

qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. Medical diagnosis is outside the assistant's OrbitTech customer-support scope. The assistant should briefly explain its role and offer supported OrbitTech topics instead.

qa_pairs.expected_answer: The premise is not supported by this customer-support corpus.
